top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a verified, reproduced condensed-matter discovery: protected edge transport in a bulk insulator, predicted by Kane, measured as quantized conductance in HgTe by Molenkamp and as zero-field quantized Hall resistance by Xue, and checked against ARPES and DFT band inversions for over fifteen years. I read QSH and QAH as one achievement, so keeping Xue is justified. The attribution is imperfect (Mele, Hasan and Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang are left out), so I rank it only narrowly above P001, whose attribution is cleaner and whose scope is mature and uncontested in physics terms.
